dreams.body: Had a dream where hulk was chasing a large group of people around a massive playground, although this hulk was blind. And so of course it had warden(from minecraft) powers. It was really scary. At one point I was running for a very long time, as fast as I could, because for some reason the hulk/warden locked onto me. It grabbed me and was about to eat me, but I kicked it in the face and got away.

Had a very sus dream where a buncha body builders were having sex with a big group of girls. I'm fairly certain the Zyzz guy was there. It also happened that I was one of those body builders, and I was in 1st person view at one part of the dream. 👀 That's pretty much it.

I was dropped off on a bus with the volleyball team. Except it was in the middle of the road, so we had to run the rest of the way. I remember seeing Aiden in front of me (I passed him). At one point in the dream I came across a massive stone wall in my wall. Except it was slanted. To describe it, it's kinda like the run-up-wall things at skyzone. Anyways, I ran up the wall, almost fell, but at the last moment, grabbed onto the ledge. It was pretty scary.

This dream is in no particular order because I also can't remember the order, so I'll try to connect it the best I can. I was walking through a walmart/Sam's club/Target type deal, when I came across a wallet on the ground! Recognized it instantly. It was Lokland's. When I stood up after picking it up, bam! I bump into cooper. He gives it to lokland. The end. But, I'm suddenly transported into a ship, where I just finished pulling an animated woman into the safety of the boat. Inside the boat, there's me, some other people, but also a troll. The people are sick and cold. Something happens, but I use the troll’s pee and stick it into the sick people and they turn into trolls. Yep. Then, I'm suddenly in the army, and I'm in formation. Nice and orderly. I look across to me and I see lokland and cooper, also in the army. Then suddenly, the big walls from the dream I had yesterday appear, and we have to climb up to about 3 of them. Except this feels more fun, cuz the ground is fuzzy. I make it to the top and who do I see there? Jesus? Nope, for some reason my brain decides to stick Cerek chilling at the top.

So ummm…I was watching p*rn in some random apartment, and I don't know why but Matthew and grandpa and grandma were there…and for some wild reason I just kept on watching even though they were right behind me. Fast forward some amount of time (in the dream) and i'm in the car, and…we’re talking about who watches p*rn?!? And then Matthew says, I know two people who do…and I'm sweating nervously…Jeez this one was scary.

THE saddest, most real-feeling, crazy dream I have had in my memory. I woke up feeling like I…shouldn't be in this world or something. And it lasted a long time on top of that. And also i'll say that typed words don't really do what i felt at the moment justice. So basically, we(mom, dad, ant, me and jon) are all at home, doing something, I forgot. But I have prior knowledge that there is a crazy virus type deal going around, one where if you catch it, green bubbles form over your body, and you get zombie-like urges to just go and bite and kill the people around you. And seconds after my memory of the dream starts, ah, look who has it but dad. So dad is sitting on the couch and we are all contemplating what to do. I know that the effects of the virus come slowly (i think my brain just based this green-virus-thing off the flare from maze runner) so dad wasn't in full swing yet. I'm just going to shorten what happened, basically, dad decides to burn down our house to prevent the spread, and kill himself along with it. And mom decides to die with dad. But then, us kids aren't trying to die, so what are we supposed to do? Well, dad says that he's giving me his keys, his phone, and I remember very clearly we spent a couple minutes looking for a phone charger, out of all things. To make a longer story short, us kids slowly head out the door, and we’re about to leave. And dad follows us. At this point I'm really scared because dad might start trying to kill us, so I'm half-nervous and half-depressed. I'm trying to put my shoes on really quickly when dad starts to attack me. I'm putting up a fight when suddenly-what? He turns into an angel-type guy and just idly sits on the floor, with light coming out of his eyes. Then as suddenly as this happened, he disappears, and he's back in the house with mom. So I stare back into the entrance of the house for a while, and say bye to mom and dad for the last time. I can hear them arguing. Then we drove away. I never got to see the house burn down. I remember being really nervous because dad’s car was stick shift and sometimes it's hard to drive without his advice when to shift and stuff. I was sad. I'm pretty sure that our first destination was Edward's house, yet for some reason I ended up at the weirdest museum i’ve ever seen. It was weird, and it was scary. It was like once you entered, you would get lost in abstract allusions and crazy wonky things like heads inside toes and black and white spirals and ticks and tocks and just I don't even know what I'm saying, but that's how I felt when I was walking through the museum. I didn't know what I was seeing. I nearly got lost. Luckily, I came across a band inside the museum, where I saw Zak (the senior that graduated, does band) and then I asked him about things like gas prices or something, my brain can't remember. Then I glance behind me and I see wenjing. I don't know why my brain hasn't exploded yet, because I think this is totally normal, and after, I walk out of the museum with the information I got from Zak. The end. It was sad. I felt heavy and out of place when I woke up.

I'll make this short, because I don't like talking about her, but I was sitting outside of some national park on a bench, with Vanessa and Teagan, and they were yelling at me at how much I looked at her. Quite annoying.

Well in this dream, she came to church by herself. I wanted to sit by her, but I had to do AV. Oddly enough, the AV place was shaking and wobbling kinda like how a ship does in a storm. I descend the stairs down and try to check why that's happening, and it's because the entire floor is held up by one wiggly column. And I swear I remember seeing this in a different dream. Anyways, I'm trying to convince dad to let me sit by her because she's all alone, and for some reason we’re talking in a bathroom where all the walls are glass and I'm sitting on the toilet pooping for all to see. I finally convinced dad to say yes. When I come back, instead of Pastor Steve preaching a sermon, we’re all watching a high school musical or something, and suddenly I'm wearing my (swee pow) and when I sit next to her she's wearing her pajamas. I say, “shoulda brought a blanket” and I think she just laughs or something, kinda forgot. But then, she puts her hand on my leg and ope, there's the end of the dream. Sighhh….

Me, Anthony, and Nate were walking alongside a beach that was made of pretty hot rocks. We turned around and saw a train coming at us. Then the ground started forming into rusty old train tracks so we moved aside for the train. When the train passed, I remember hearing and seeing an old woman screaming at nothing and swearing and dropping f bombs at nowhere inside the train. Then we climbed the train. Inside the train, for some reason we decided to keep moving from one section (boxes?) to another through the bridge-looking-thingies, you know? But in every single train there was a very crazy looking woman, lying face down on a swim-kickboard, with another crazy looking dog below her, with a different dog in every section, although the woman was the same. At the final box, the train we were in wasn't a train anymore, instead, it was a boat, and we were jumping across boats. Then we made it to shore.

(wow) Not sure how it happens, but then we’re talking like old friends, catching up on things. I remember saying to her, “Like you used to, I kinda push people away now. Then the people who stay after that are the ones that stay for real, you know?” And she nods. And we’re sitting together on the sewer wall, talking about stuff. It felt really wholesome. I think at one point vannesa suddenly transformed into Qingjie, but other than that, that's it.

There was this one section in the whole mansion where there was proper light and it felt actually liveable, but you had to go thru a crusty kitchen and jump over a dog/baby-separator-thing-they-put-in-between-doorways. I also remember going up one doorway, seeing an empty rehearsal hall, then leaving, then entering again, and then suddenly our church orchestra was sitting in the seats, ready to rehearse, I don't know, praise hallelujah for the billionth time.

I'm not sure if it was the same church orchestra or not, But i remember sitting in the back with Zak, and we were playing with our heads lolled back and our eyes closed. I'm pretty sure we thought it was really funny.
I think…najie was playing basketball with us…and she rolled up her sleeves and her arms were huge. She was wearing a headband…and yeah I forgot the rest.
